name: Medad
bio: Medad is one of the elders of Israel, chosen by Moses as one of seventy elders to help govern the people. When God took of the Spirit that was on Moses and gave it to the seventy elders, causing them to prophesy before the tabernacle, Medad and Eldad had not gone out to the tabernacle but remained in the camp — yet the Spirit rested on them there too, and they prophesied in the camp. A young man ran to tell Moses, and Joshua urged him to stop them, but Moses replied, "Would God that all the LORD's people were prophets, and that the LORD would put his spirit upon them!" (Numbers 11:24-29)
